name: story-mode-review-gate
description: Enforce human review gate before any git commit in story mode
message:
🛑 Review Gate: Story Mode Commits Require Approval

Before committing changes, please review:
1. ✓ All changes match the planned tasks from the story plan
2. ✓ Code quality and tests pass
3. ✓ Commit message follows convention (e.g. READY/TICKET-XXXX format)
4. ✓ No unintended files are staged

To proceed with commit, reply: 'approve commit' or provide any corrections needed.

NOTE (starter kit): this JSON documents the intended hook shape. Whether your agent runtime actually loads and enforces a file like this depends on the runtime — see STORY_MODE_REVIEW_GATE.md before assuming this is wired up.
